[Company name masked] is the largest school transportation provider in [Location masked] with more than a century of experience providing safe and reliable transportation. We work with 1,250 school districts in 39 states and 8 [Location masked] provinces carrying approximately five million students in 21,000 schools daily.
The Routing Analyst is responsible for building and maintaining accurate and efficient route schemes in routing systems for [Company name masked] locations and our school district customer. Recognizes and resolves issues associated with data loading, data quality, etc.
Coordinate routing updates and change requests across multiple locations.
Acts as day-to-day point contact for [Company name masked] location staff and school district administrators.
Keep supervisor apprised of any issues, challenges, special requests in locations.
Assist other [Company name masked] staff with complex analyses in various software packages of student, transportation, boundary, or other data.
Logs hours worked and other relevant project information into web-based tracking tool.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned including help with special projects.
